(rule!
  (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)]) ([color (in-list (grid-colors g 0))])
    (let* ((bb (bbox-of-cells (find-color g color)))
           (corners (list (list (first bb) (second bb) color)
                          (list (first bb) (fourth bb) color)
                          (list (third bb) (second bb) color)
                          (list (third bb) (fourth bb) color))))
      (paint-cells out corners))))

(rule!
  (let* ([records
          (for/list ([color (in-list (grid-colors g 0))])
            (let* ([cells (find-color g color)]
                   [bb (bbox-of-cells cells)])
              (list color bb (length cells))))]
         [area (lambda (record)
                 (let ([bb (second record)])
                   (* (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb)))
                      (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb))))))]
         [selected
          (for/fold ([best (first records)]) ([record (in-list (rest records))])
            (if (> (area record) (area best)) record best))]
         [color (first selected)]
         [bb (second selected)])
    (paint-cells
      (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)
      (for*/list ([row (in-range (first bb) (+ 1 (third bb)))]
                  [col (in-range (second bb) (+ 1 (fourth bb)))]
                  #:when (or (= row (first bb)) (= row (third bb))
                             (= col (second bb)) (= col (fourth bb))))
        (list row col color)))))
